tasks.title: Restore internal consistency across package manifests, workflow contracts, and maintainer/downstream quality gates
acceptance_criteria: devgod package manifests, shipped files, and agent catalogs match the actual repo surface
workflow templates, scaffold output, and workflow checkers agree on the same required sections and states
core repo quality gates pass or any remaining blocker is isolated, intentional, and documented with follow-up priorities
duplication, unnecessary surfaces, workflow holes, and real development blockers are identified in a written gap summary

tasks.title: Eliminate package.json files-list drift with a canonical shipped-surface verifier
acceptance_criteria: one canonical helper defines the expected package.json files surface
package verification fails on missing or unexpected manifest entries before pack time
package-surface tests reuse the canonical helper instead of copied lists where practical
workflow artifacts and product state reflect the completed slice and next follow-up

tasks.title: Centralize duplicated workflow schema definitions across template, checker, scaffold, and tests
acceptance_criteria: one canonical workflow-schema source is reused by checker, templates, and tests
duplicated task-packet schema definitions are removed or reduced to generated or verified consumers
scaffold and workflow-check behavior stay stable with no regression
workflow artifacts and maintainer summary are updated to reflect the completed slice
